content_sections.heading: About DUK Research Intern Recruitment
content_sections.text: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology, also known as Digital University Kerala, has its campus at Technocity Campus, Mangalapuram, Thonnakkal PO, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala - 695 317. The Research Intern posts are for the NPDD10H-Digitisation Proposal for the Design & Development of Sensor-based Monitoring System, ERP System Study, and Gap Analysis, ERP Process Study-173 BMCU connected Software, funded by Milma. The university can be contacted at +91-471-2788000 or [email protected] , as printed on its letterhead.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There are three Research Intern posts under Job Code RI/112026/446. The essential educational qualification is M.Sc. in Electronics OR M.Tech Electronics Engineering from a recognized University/Educational Institution. Candidates also need minimum one year of research/industry experience relevant to the field of embedded system development after the qualifying degree. The age should not exceed 30 years as of the last date for submission of application. The notice gives the following age relaxation: Electronic Circuit Design Firmware Coding IoT System Development The appointment is purely on a contract basis for an initial period of three months. The contract may be extended based on the candidate's performance, project requirements and availability of funds. The job location is given as Thiruvananthapuram district. For the full eligibility details of the post, candidates can refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: DUK Research Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: Design, develop, and test embedded hardware and firmware for microcontroller- and IoT-based systems. Interface and integrate various sensors, communication modules, and peripheral devices with embedded hardware. Develop and validate wireless communication solutions using technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GSM/GPRS, LoRa, or GNSS, as applicable. Perform hardware bring-up, debugging, system integration, and field testing to ensure reliable system performance. Collaborate in the design and implementation of low-power, real-time embedded systems for monitoring and automation applications. Prepare technical documentation, conduct system validation, and contribute to prototype development and product optimization.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: All original certificates, for verification at the time of the interview. A set of self-attested photocopies (Age, Date of Birth, Qualification, Experience, etc.). Candidates who fail to produce the original certificates for verification will not be allowed to attend the interview, leading to forfeiture of candidature.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The selection will be based on a test and Interview. The test/interview will be conducted in Thiruvananthapuram district only. Original certificates are verified at the time of the interview. The selection or appointment will be provisional and subject to physical verification of the documents.

faq.question: Q1. When is the DUK Research Intern walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 09 December 2026, from 09:30 AM to 11.00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the DUK Research Intern walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue is Digital University Campus at Technocity, Technopark Phase IV, Mangalapuram, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q3. How many Research Intern vacancies are there?
faq.answer: Digital University Kerala has announced three Research Intern vacancies under Job Code RI/112026/446.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the DUK Research Intern post?
faq.answer: Candidates need M.Sc. in Electronics OR M.Tech Electronics Engineering from a recognized University/Educational Institution, plus minimum one year of research/industry experience in embedded system development after the qualifying degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the DUK Research Intern post?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 30 years as of the last date for submission of application, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for the DUK Research Intern?
faq.answer: The Research Intern gets a stipend of Rs.22,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original certificates and a set of self-attested photocopies (Age, Date of Birth, Qualification, Experience, etc.); without the originals, they will not be allowed to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will DUK select Research Interns?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on a test and Interview, conducted in Thiruvananthapuram district only.

faq.question: Q9. Is the DUK Research Intern post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely on a contract basis for an initial period of three months, which may be extended based on performance, project requirements and availability of funds.

faq.question: Q10. Which project are the DUK Research Intern posts for?
faq.answer: The posts are for the NPDD10H-Digitisation Proposal for the Design & Development of Sensor-based Monitoring System, ERP System Study, and Gap Analysis, ERP Process Study-173 BMCU connected Software, funded by Milma.
